scene.label: Act 1, Scene 1
scene.title: SCENE I. Antioch. A room in the palace.
scene.location: Antioch. A room in the palace.

content.text: Enter Antiochus, Prince Pericles and followers.

lines.text: Young prince of Tyre, you have at large received
lines.plainText: Young prince of Tyre you have at large received

lines.text: The danger of the task you undertake.
lines.plainText: The danger of the task you undertake

lines.text: I have, Antiochus, and, with a soul
lines.plainText: I have Antiochus and with a soul

lines.text: Emboldened with the glory of her praise,
lines.plainText: Emboldened with the glory of her praise

lines.text: Think death no hazard in this enterprise.
lines.plainText: Think death no hazard in this enterprise

lines.text: Music! Bring in our daughter, clothed like a bride,
lines.plainText: Music Bring in our daughter clothed like a bride

lines.text: For the embracements even of Jove himself;
lines.plainText: For the embracements even of Jove himself

lines.text: At whose conception, till Lucina reigned,
lines.plainText: At whose conception till Lucina reigned

lines.text: Nature this dowry gave, to glad her presence,
lines.plainText: Nature this dowry gave to glad her presence

lines.text: The senate house of planets all did sit,
lines.plainText: The senate house of planets all did sit

lines.text: To knit in her their best perfections.
lines.plainText: To knit in her their best perfections

content.text: Music. Enter the Daughter of Antiochus.

lines.text: See where she comes, apparell'd like the spring,
lines.plainText: See where she comes apparell'd like the spring

lines.text: Graces her subjects, and her thoughts the king
lines.plainText: Graces her subjects and her thoughts the king

lines.text: Of every virtue gives renown to men!
lines.plainText: Of every virtue gives renown to men

lines.text: Her face the book of praises, where is read
lines.plainText: Her face the book of praises where is read

lines.text: Nothing but curious pleasures, as from thence
lines.plainText: Nothing but curious pleasures as from thence

lines.text: Sorrow were ever razed, and testy wrath
lines.plainText: Sorrow were ever razed and testy wrath

lines.text: Could never be her mild companion.
lines.plainText: Could never be her mild companion

lines.text: You gods that made me man, and sway in love,
lines.plainText: You gods that made me man and sway in love

lines.text: That have inflamed desire in my breast
lines.plainText: That have inflamed desire in my breast

lines.text: To taste the fruit of yon celestial tree,
lines.plainText: To taste the fruit of yon celestial tree

lines.text: Or die in the adventure, be my helps,
lines.plainText: Or die in the adventure be my helps

lines.text: As I am son and servant to your will,
lines.plainText: As I am son and servant to your will

lines.text: To compass such a boundless happiness!
lines.plainText: To compass such a boundless happiness

lines.text: Prince Pericles,—
lines.plainText: Prince Pericles

lines.text: That would be son to great Antiochus.
lines.plainText: That would be son to great Antiochus

lines.text: Before thee stands this fair Hesperides,
lines.plainText: Before thee stands this fair Hesperides

lines.text: With golden fruit, but dangerous to be touch'd;
lines.plainText: With golden fruit but dangerous to be touch'd

lines.text: For death-like dragons here affright thee hard:
lines.plainText: For deathlike dragons here affright thee hard

lines.text: Her face, like heaven, enticeth thee to view
lines.plainText: Her face like heaven enticeth thee to view

lines.text: Her countless glory, which desert must gain;
lines.plainText: Her countless glory which desert must gain

lines.text: And which, without desert, because thine eye
lines.plainText: And which without desert because thine eye

lines.text: Presumes to reach, all the whole heap must die.
lines.plainText: Presumes to reach all the whole heap must die

lines.text: Yon sometimes famous princes, like thyself,
lines.plainText: Yon sometimes famous princes like thyself

lines.text: Drawn by report, adventurous by desire,
lines.plainText: Drawn by report adventurous by desire

lines.text: Tell thee, with speechless tongues and semblance pale,
lines.plainText: Tell thee with speechless tongues and semblance pale

lines.text: That without covering, save yon field of stars,
lines.plainText: That without covering save yon field of stars

lines.text: Here they stand Martyrs, slain in Cupid's wars;
lines.plainText: Here they stand Martyrs slain in Cupid's wars

lines.text: And with dead cheeks advise thee to desist
lines.plainText: And with dead cheeks advise thee to desist

lines.text: For going on death's net, whom none resist.
lines.plainText: For going on death's net whom none resist

lines.text: Antiochus, I thank thee, who hath taught
lines.plainText: Antiochus I thank thee who hath taught

lines.text: My frail mortality to know itself,
lines.plainText: My frail mortality to know itself

lines.text: And by those fearful objects to prepare
lines.plainText: And by those fearful objects to prepare

lines.text: This body, like to them, to what I must;
lines.plainText: This body like to them to what I must

lines.text: For death remember'd should be like a mirror,
lines.plainText: For death remember'd should be like a mirror

lines.text: Who tells us life's but breath, to trust it error.
lines.plainText: Who tells us life's but breath to trust it error

lines.text: I'll make my will then, and, as sick men do
lines.plainText: I'll make my will then and as sick men do

lines.text: Who know the world, see heaven, but, feeling woe,
lines.plainText: Who know the world see heaven but feeling woe

lines.text: Gripe not at earthly joys as erst they did;
lines.plainText: Gripe not at earthly joys as erst they did

lines.text: So I bequeath a happy peace to you
lines.plainText: So I bequeath a happy peace to you

lines.text: And all good men, as every prince should do;
lines.plainText: And all good men as every prince should do

lines.text: My riches to the earth from whence they came;
lines.plainText: My riches to the earth from whence they came

lines.text: [To the daughter of Antiochus.] But my unspotted fire of love to you.
lines.plainText: To the daughter of Antiochus But my unspotted fire of love to you

lines.text: Thus ready for the way of life or death,
lines.plainText: Thus ready for the way of life or death

lines.text: I wait the sharpest blow, Antiochus.
lines.plainText: I wait the sharpest blow Antiochus

lines.text: Scorning advice, read the conclusion, then:
lines.plainText: Scorning advice read the conclusion then

lines.text: Which read and not expounded, 'tis decreed,
lines.plainText: Which read and not expounded 'tis decreed

lines.text: As these before thee thou thyself shalt bleed.
lines.plainText: As these before thee thou thyself shalt bleed

lines.text: Of all 'ssayed yet, mayst thou prove prosperous!
lines.plainText: Of all 'ssayed yet mayst thou prove prosperous

lines.text: Of all 'ssayed yet, I wish thee happiness!
lines.plainText: Of all 'ssayed yet I wish thee happiness

lines.text: Like a bold champion, I assume the lists,
lines.plainText: Like a bold champion I assume the lists

lines.text: Nor ask advice of any other thought
lines.plainText: Nor ask advice of any other thought

lines.text: But faithfulness and courage.
lines.plainText: But faithfulness and courage

content.text: [Takes hold of the hand of the Princess.]

lines.text: Prince Pericles, touch not, upon thy life,
lines.plainText: Prince Pericles touch not upon thy life

lines.text: For that's an article within our law,
lines.plainText: For that's an article within our law

lines.text: As dangerous as the rest. Your time's expired:
lines.plainText: As dangerous as the rest Your time's expired

lines.text: Either expound now, or receive your sentence.
lines.plainText: Either expound now or receive your sentence

lines.text: Great king,
lines.plainText: Great king

lines.text: Few love to hear the sins they love to act;
lines.plainText: Few love to hear the sins they love to act

lines.text: 'Twould braid yourself too near for me to tell it.
lines.plainText: 'Twould braid yourself too near for me to tell it

lines.text: Who has a book of all that monarchs do,
lines.plainText: Who has a book of all that monarchs do

lines.text: He's more secure to keep it shut than shown:
lines.plainText: He's more secure to keep it shut than shown

lines.text: For vice repeated is like the wandering wind,
lines.plainText: For vice repeated is like the wandering wind

lines.text: Blows dust in others' eyes, to spread itself;
lines.plainText: Blows dust in others' eyes to spread itself

lines.text: And yet the end of all is bought thus dear,
lines.plainText: And yet the end of all is bought thus dear

lines.text: The breath is gone, and the sore eyes see clear.
lines.plainText: The breath is gone and the sore eyes see clear

lines.text: To stop the air would hurt them. The blind mole casts
lines.plainText: To stop the air would hurt them The blind mole casts

lines.text: Copp'd hills towards heaven, to tell the earth is throng'd
lines.plainText: Copp'd hills towards heaven to tell the earth is throng'd

lines.text: By man's oppression; and the poor worm doth die for't.
lines.plainText: By man's oppression and the poor worm doth die for't

lines.text: Kind are earth's gods; in vice their law's their will;
lines.plainText: Kind are earth's gods in vice their law's their will

lines.text: And if Jove stray, who dares say Jove doth ill?
lines.plainText: And if Jove stray who dares say Jove doth ill

lines.text: It is enough you know; and it is fit,
lines.plainText: It is enough you know and it is fit

lines.text: What being more known grows worse, to smother it.
lines.plainText: What being more known grows worse to smother it

lines.text: All love the womb that their first bred,
lines.plainText: All love the womb that their first bred

lines.text: Then give my tongue like leave to love my head.
lines.plainText: Then give my tongue like leave to love my head

lines.text: [Aside] Heaven, that I had thy head! He has found the meaning:
lines.plainText: Aside Heaven that I had thy head He has found the meaning

lines.text: But I will gloze with him.—Young prince of Tyre.
lines.plainText: But I will gloze with himYoung prince of Tyre

lines.text: Though by the tenour of our strict edict,
lines.plainText: Though by the tenour of our strict edict

lines.text: Your exposition misinterpreting,
lines.plainText: Your exposition misinterpreting

lines.text: We might proceed to cancel of your days;
lines.plainText: We might proceed to cancel of your days

lines.text: Yet hope, succeeding from so fair a tree
lines.plainText: Yet hope succeeding from so fair a tree

lines.text: As your fair self, doth tune us otherwise:
lines.plainText: As your fair self doth tune us otherwise

lines.text: Forty days longer we do respite you;
lines.plainText: Forty days longer we do respite you

lines.text: If by which time our secret be undone,
lines.plainText: If by which time our secret be undone

lines.text: This mercy shows we'll joy in such a son:
lines.plainText: This mercy shows we'll joy in such a son

lines.text: And until then your entertain shall be
lines.plainText: And until then your entertain shall be

lines.text: As doth befit our honour and your worth.
lines.plainText: As doth befit our honour and your worth

lines.text: How courtesy would seem to cover sin,
lines.plainText: How courtesy would seem to cover sin

lines.text: When what is done is like an hypocrite,
lines.plainText: When what is done is like an hypocrite

lines.text: The which is good in nothing but in sight!
lines.plainText: The which is good in nothing but in sight

lines.text: If it be true that I interpret false,
lines.plainText: If it be true that I interpret false

lines.text: Then were it certain you were not so bad
lines.plainText: Then were it certain you were not so bad

lines.text: As with foul incest to abuse your soul;
lines.plainText: As with foul incest to abuse your soul

lines.text: Where now you're both a father and a son,
lines.plainText: Where now you're both a father and a son

lines.text: By your untimely claspings with your child,
lines.plainText: By your untimely claspings with your child

lines.text: Which pleasures fits a husband, not a father;
lines.plainText: Which pleasures fits a husband not a father

lines.text: And she an eater of her mother's flesh,
lines.plainText: And she an eater of her mother's flesh

lines.text: By the defiling of her parent's bed;
lines.plainText: By the defiling of her parent's bed

lines.text: And both like serpents are, who though they feed
lines.plainText: And both like serpents are who though they feed

lines.text: On sweetest flowers, yet they poison breed.
lines.plainText: On sweetest flowers yet they poison breed

lines.text: Antioch, farewell! for wisdom sees, those men
lines.plainText: Antioch farewell for wisdom sees those men

lines.text: Blush not in actions blacker than the night,
lines.plainText: Blush not in actions blacker than the night

lines.text: Will 'schew no course to keep them from the light.
lines.plainText: Will 'schew no course to keep them from the light

lines.text: One sin, I know, another doth provoke;
lines.plainText: One sin I know another doth provoke

lines.text: Murder's as near to lust as flame to smoke:
lines.plainText: Murder's as near to lust as flame to smoke

lines.text: Poison and treason are the hands of sin,
lines.plainText: Poison and treason are the hands of sin

lines.text: Ay, and the targets, to put off the shame:
lines.plainText: Ay and the targets to put off the shame

lines.text: Then, lest my life be cropp'd to keep you clear,
lines.plainText: Then lest my life be cropp'd to keep you clear

lines.text: By flight I'll shun the danger which I fear.
lines.plainText: By flight I'll shun the danger which I fear

lines.text: He hath found the meaning,
lines.plainText: He hath found the meaning

lines.text: For which we mean to have his head.
lines.plainText: For which we mean to have his head

lines.text: He must not live to trumpet forth my infamy,
lines.plainText: He must not live to trumpet forth my infamy

lines.text: Nor tell the world Antiochus doth sin
lines.plainText: Nor tell the world Antiochus doth sin

lines.text: In such a loathed manner;
lines.plainText: In such a loathed manner

lines.text: And therefore instantly this prince must die;
lines.plainText: And therefore instantly this prince must die

lines.text: For by his fall my honour must keep high.
lines.plainText: For by his fall my honour must keep high

lines.text: Who attends us there?
lines.plainText: Who attends us there

lines.text: Doth your highness call?
lines.plainText: Doth your highness call

lines.text: Thaliard, you are of our chamber,
lines.plainText: Thaliard you are of our chamber

lines.text: And our mind partakes her private actions
lines.plainText: And our mind partakes her private actions

lines.text: To your secrecy; and for your faithfulness
lines.plainText: To your secrecy and for your faithfulness

lines.text: We will advance you. Thaliard,
lines.plainText: We will advance you Thaliard

lines.text: Behold, here's poison, and here's gold;
lines.plainText: Behold here's poison and here's gold

lines.text: We hate the prince of Tyre, and thou must kill him:
lines.plainText: We hate the prince of Tyre and thou must kill him

lines.text: It fits thee not to ask the reason why,
lines.plainText: It fits thee not to ask the reason why

lines.text: Because we bid it. Say, is it done?
lines.plainText: Because we bid it Say is it done

lines.text: My lord, 'tis done.
lines.plainText: My lord 'tis done

lines.text: Enough.
lines.plainText: Enough

lines.text: My lord, Prince Pericles is fled.
lines.plainText: My lord Prince Pericles is fled

lines.text: As thou wilt live, fly after: and like an arrow shot
lines.plainText: As thou wilt live fly after and like an arrow shot

lines.text: From a well-experienced archer hits the mark
lines.plainText: From a wellexperienced archer hits the mark

lines.text: His eye doth level at, so thou ne'er return
lines.plainText: His eye doth level at so thou ne'er return

lines.text: Unless thou say 'Prince Pericles is dead.'
lines.plainText: Unless thou say 'Prince Pericles is dead'

lines.text: My lord, if I can get him within my pistol's length, I'll make him sure enough: so, farewell to your highness.
lines.plainText: My lord if I can get him within my pistol's length I'll make him sure enough so farewell to your highness

lines.text: Thaliard! adieu!
lines.plainText: Thaliard adieu
